config_changes: Official compose apiserver memory limit remained 2g.
Host ports were bound to 127.0.0.1 as in the case-local compose copy.

reachability.account_used: team API key with BOM_UPLOAD only

steps: Started official Dependency-Track compose and waited for GET /api/version to return HTTP 200.
Used default admin/admin only for isolated bootstrap; the application required FORCE_PASSWORD_CHANGE, so the probe changed the admin password to a case-local value.
Created or reused one team named codex-dos-bom-upload-team-0001.
Assigned only BOM_UPLOAD to the team.
Generated a team API key and verified /api/v1/team/self with that key.
Created or reused one project named codex-dos-bom-heap-0001 version 1.0.

trigger.request_shape: POST /api/v1/bom multipart/form-data with project=<uuid> and bom file part containing attacker-controlled JSON bytes
trigger.bandwidth_notes: Single-client, single-concurrency local HTTP probe. 1-512MiB multipart payloads returned application 400 while keeping service healthy; the 768MiB multipart payload returned HTTP 500 and logged Java heap OOM.

utilization_conditions.summary: 官方 Dependency-Track 5.0.2 compose 默认 apiserver 2GiB 内存下，持有 BOM_UPLOAD 的低权限 API key 可通过单个约 768MiB multipart BOM part 触发目标 JVM Java heap OutOfMemoryError；进程未退出但请求返回 500，日志确认 OOM。
limits_or_mitigations: BOM upload requires an authenticated principal with BOM_UPLOAD.
Limit multipart body size, BOM part size, upload rate, and per-project/per-user upload quota before BomResource accumulates the stream.
Avoid granting BOM_UPLOAD to low-trust users or restrict it to trusted automation paths.
A reverse proxy or gateway body-size limit below the observed threshold would block this proof.
not_affected_when: No accessible project exists for the API key.
Ingress rejects large multipart requests before they reach the apiserver.
The application enforces a strict BOM byte limit before IOUtils.toByteArray materializes the part.

static_traceability.source: PUT /v1/bom JSON base64 and POST /v1/bom multipart require BOM_UPLOAD; multipart bom part is attacker-controlled by that principal.
static_traceability.sink: BomResource reads decoded BOM or multipart part with IOUtils.toByteArray into byte[] before validateBom and processUpload.
static_traceability.driver: BOM byte volume per request; repeated accepted uploads also create workflow run metadata with unique upload tokens.
missing_static_evidence: Effective default reverse proxy/container body-size limit
Jersey multipart provider in-memory versus temp-file behavior for large parts
Default role/team assignment prevalence for BOM_UPLOAD

notes: The first retest probe fixed admin FORCE_PASSWORD_CHANGE handling and prepared a BOM_UPLOAD-only API key, but the copied multipart sender initially emitted duplicate Host headers; that preliminary file is retained as evidence/probe_observations.put_and_broken_multipart.json.
After fixing the multipart sender, valid smoke upload returned 200 and invalid 1-512MiB multipart BOMs returned 400 while driving memory close to the 2GiB compose limit.
The final 768MiB multipart request returned HTTP 500; apiserver logs include jakarta.servlet.ServletException wrapping java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space.
